name: Reporting To and Reportees offer every active user beyond 100
description:
Objective: Reporting To and Reportees offer every active user beyond 100.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the exact configured origin; Superadmin automation account; every user, role and permission set the test creates is automation-owned (QA name, qa.*@kesef.com) and registered for exact cleanup.
Steps:
1. Create automation-owned users until more than 100 are active.
2. Open Add User; read Reporting To and Reportees options.
3. Compare with active users on API page 2; search the selector for any user not in the first batch.
Expected: Every active user can be chosen as a manager or reportee.
